Alexander Sorloth.note: Watch Sørloth for using strength without slowing the next action. He shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it.
Alexander Sorloth.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗中用力量但不拖慢下一步。留意他如何把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。

Andreas Schjelderup.note: Schjelderup stands out for seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Andreas Schjelderup.noteZh: 他的突出特点是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Antonio Nusa.note: Watch Nusa for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Antonio Nusa.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。留意他如何提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

David Moller Wolfe.note: Watch Wolfe for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
David Moller Wolfe.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Egil Selvik.note: Selvik stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Egil Selvik.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Erling Haaland.note: Haaland's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He absorbs contact and keeps the ball close enough to continue forward. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Erling Haaland.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会承受身体接触后仍把球留在可继续推进的位置。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.note: Bjørkan stands out for choosing the moment to join an attack from deep. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Fredrik Andre Bjorkan.noteZh: 他的突出特点是从后场加入进攻的启动时机。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Fredrik Aursnes.note: Watch Aursnes for reading the next phase before the space fully opens. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Fredrik Aursnes.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在空当完全出现前读懂下一阶段。留意他如何出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Henrik Falchener.note: Falchener's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Henrik Falchener.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。

Jens Petter Hauge.note: Watch Hauge for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Jens Petter Hauge.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。留意他如何把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Jorgen Strand Larsen.note: Larsen's signature is making the next teammate's action easier. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Jorgen Strand Larsen.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在让队友下一步处理更轻松上。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Julian Ryerson.note: Ryerson stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He holds the route into the box until support arrives. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Julian Ryerson.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Kristian Thorstvedt.note: Watch Thorstvedt for creating a better angle for the next pass. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He shifts onto his left foot and shoots with little backlift.
Kristian Thorstvedt.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会把球调整到左脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Kristoffer Ajer.note: Ajer's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Kristoffer Ajer.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Leo Ostigard.note: Østigård's signature is choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Leo Ostigard.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Marcus Holmgren Pedersen.note: Watch Pedersen for recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Marcus Holmgren Pedersen.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是防线暴露后的回追速度。留意他如何等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Martin Odegaard.note: Ødegaard's edge is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Martin Odegaard.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是比防线早一步看到决定性的传球。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Morten Thorsby.note: Thorsby is defined by choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Morten Thorsby.noteZh: 他靠选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Orjan Nyland.summary: Ørjan Nyland is a Norway goalkeeper from Sevilla FC who gives the national team veteran shot stopping, box command, and tournament experience.
Orjan Nyland.note: Nyland stands out for sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He recognizes when to slow the play and when to take the risk.
Orjan Nyland.noteZh: 他的突出特点是提前站位后的快速反应。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会判断何时放慢节奏，何时承担风险。

Oscar Bobb.note: Bobb's edge is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Oscar Bobb.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Patrick Berg.note: Berg stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Patrick Berg.noteZh: 他的突出特点是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Sander Berge.note: Berge's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Sander Berge.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Sander Tangvik.note: Tangvik stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Sander Tangvik.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Sondre Langas.note: Langås is defined by protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He changes position while keeping his priorities simple.
Sondre Langas.noteZh: 他靠先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会改变起始位置，但始终坚持清晰简单的处理原则。

Thelo Aasgaard.note: Watch Aasgaard for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Thelo Aasgaard.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Torbjorn Heggem.note: Heggem stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball.
Torbjorn Heggem.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。他也会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。
